_about: lanePOTIONS v1 (supersedes laneMARKET v1). Read by PotionCfg.cs. enabled false = the whole feature is OFF (no use key, no HUD chip, no stack trade, the save keeps any stacks it holds). Fractions are of the player's max health / stamina (DuelFighter maxHealth 150, maxStamina 100). overSeconds > 0 pays the amount out per sim tick over that time. cooldownS is per potion id. buyValue = the vendor price in silver (stock it by listing the id in a stall's items: market.json stalls[].items / hub.json stall.buy.items; sell = market.json rules.sellRatio x buyValue, at least minSell). maxCarry caps the stack. Only kind heal and stamina are implemented; the poise tonic (kind buff) stays as data and is neither sold nor usable until a stat hook exists.
_keysNote: R is the camera recenter (controls.json), pad button 3 is the stall Buy tab, 7 closes the panel, 8 is the bow toggle, 9 is used by controls. H, J and pad 6 (Back / View) are unused in controls.json, loot_ui.json, hub.json and the Roslyn KeyCode scan.
